newsitem.title: CHINA: China to control shopping centre construction.
newsitem.headline: China to control shopping centre construction.

text.p: China's Ministry of Internal Trade has ordered strict controls on the construction of large high-class shopping centres in the second half of this year, the Economic Daily said on Tuesday.
The ministry had called for the development of convenience stores and groceries in urban areas to meet demand from residents for daily necessities, the newspaper said.
New stores could be created by combining grain shops and vegetable shops, the newspaper said but gave no details.
Ministry officials contacted by telephone declined to comment on the report or give details of the new controls on shopping centre construction.

Beijing has repeatedly called for property developers to focus more on building low-cost housing for urban residents and to cut back on the construction of high-profile shopping centres and luxury apartments.
